recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if Pharmacy changes the CodeableReference target or the code-versus-reference guidance; FHIR-5633 itself is already represented in the current source.
issue_request: FHIR-5633 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy DSTU1 change request asking that medication elements not force implementers to create a Medication resource when only a medication code is available; the approved resolution was a choice of CodeableConcept or Resource(Medication).
initial_application: No current source-history commit was found with an explicit FHIR-5633 reference, but the model was already present in the historical source family. Later history includes FHIR-10389 guidance on code versus Medication reference use and FHIR-25929 conversion of Pharmacy CodeableConcept-or-Reference choices to CodeableReference.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini makes MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement active build-scope resources and records that MedicationPrescription became MedicationRequest. Current StructureDefinition source for all four uses CodeableReference with targetProfile Medication, medication-code bindings, and guidance comments; this preserves the FHIR-5633 semantics without adding Substance as a reference target.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already satisfies the approved coded-or-Medication-reference choice, so editing would have been redundant and could create maintenance drift.

related_jiras.note: Added explicit guidance about when to use a medication code versus a Medication resource reference on the same elements.
Converted Pharmacy CodeableConcept-or-Reference choices, including these medication elements, to CodeableReference for R5.
Later question about searching medicationCodeableConcept confirms implementer awareness of the coded branch but does not require a source change for this seed.

evidence_items.learned: The current source already represents the approved coded-or-Medication-reference choice and does not allow Substance as a reference target.
